verdict.rationale: The evidence pack gives the RTX 5080's memory specs as 16 GB on a 256-bit bus with 960 GB/s of GDDR7 bandwidth, half the 5090's memory. Nothing in the pack shows or claims that a 70B-class quantized LLM fits or runs practically on this card. NVIDIA's general statements about running the latest AI models locally (via Ollama, PyTorch and similar backends) do not address 70B-class models or VRAM sufficiency, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical
